name: 3-jaw chuck
description: 10 in hydraulic three-jaw power chuck for the ST-25 spindle; soft jaws are bored to hold each part.

key_specs.name: Chuck diameter
key_specs.note: 10 in, the ST-25's standard chuck size

key_specs.name: Jaws
key_specs.value: 3 jaws, serrated master jaws for standard Kitagawa soft jaws (SJ)

key_specs.name: Mount
key_specs.value: Recess mount; A2-6 spindle nose (ST-25) through an adaptor plate

license: Kitagawa Corporation CAD data, downloaded under Kitagawa's terms of use (accepted 2026-10-19 at your request): no reproducing or altering it for profit; not self-made or CC0
notes: Kitagawa's own STEP from brchuck.com, jaws in the closed (OC) position; the open-jaw (UC) file is kept as an original. Includes the soft jaws, T-nuts, cover, draw nut and the three M16 mounting bolts. Axis along X, as it sits on the lathe spindle. 3Dfindit needs a login, and the GrabCAD 'Kitagawa B12' is a 12 in chuck, the wrong size for the ST-25.
